name: Clean Microsoft Teams cache (Windows)
description: Clears classic Teams cache folders and the new Teams local cache for all user profiles. Skips everything if Teams is running and skip_running is true. Dry run by default.

params.name: skip_running
params.label: Skip if Teams is running
params.description: When true, nothing is cleaned while Teams is running.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

output: Per-folder [DONE]/[DRY-RUN]/[SKIP] lines and total bytes. Exit 0.
